verdict.rationale: Sprinto is a SaaS compliance platform rather than an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a first-party MCP server or endpoint. The goSprinto compliance-skills repo (agent skills installed via npx), llms.txt, the APIs and the inbound webhooks are all adjacent features or developer building blocks, so none of them count toward this story.
